The site in which its eye is located also serves as its mouth, and it seems to turn completely blind while eating.

species.name: GulusGammamon
species.flavor: A ferocious Digimon that evolved when the evil heart hidden within Gammamon was unleashed. It rejects interference from those around it and is only interested in fighting, and once it catches an opponent that comes into sight, it will not stop attacking them until they breathe their last breath. It puts up ferocious battles where it attacks regardless of whether its limbs get broken.

species.name: Gurimon
species.flavor: A Baby Digimon that grew up from Curimon and now has two horns on its brow. It bounces around energetically, and when it finds large, hard rocks, it strikes them with its horn-charging Signature Move "Chikuchiku Attack". It enjoys coming across whole rocks, and runs around bursting with energy to become even stronger.

species.name: Hiyarimon
species.flavor: A Lesser Digimon that evolved from Yukimi Botamon. The fluffy cilia it once had are now gone, and instead the surface of its body is always covered with snow. It lives mostly in snowy mountains, and its body melts when exposed to sunlight, so it is active after sunset.

species.name: Hydramon
species.flavor: A gigantic Plant Digimon that primarily takes root in swampland. It constantly secretes a highly-toxic liquid from its whole body, which it mercilessly uses to dissolve anyone that touches it and preys on them. Also, it has a habit of expelling large amounts of that liquid from its abdomen, melting the ground and creating swamps to expand its nest.

species.name: Jellymon
species.flavor: A Mollusk Digimon with a squishy head like a jellyfish. Its whole body is flexible, which allows it to retract its body into its head, and it usually lives with just its head showing. While it is in this form, it is light enough to fly just by being blown by the wind.

species.name: KausGammamon
species.flavor: A form in which Gammamon grew up, and its body turned blue due to its calm and clear mind. It soars like a glider by spreading the membranes under both of its arms, allowing it to fly far from high places, or rise just briefly while gliding using the jet ports on its knees. It is always calm, cool, and collected, and fights by seeing through the opponent's movements.

species.name: KodokugumonChild
species.flavor: A Child Digimon with the appearance of a spider that behaves in clusters with Dokugumon. It is usually docile and hangs from things such as tree branches with its body curled into a ball, but if an enemy approaches, it attacks en masse from overhead. It wears gloves with a strong poison on the claws because it is unable to produce a strong poison of its own yet.

species.name: Komondomon
species.flavor: A vehicle Digimon that loves to move around while carrying other Digimon. It feels like it is taking a walk wherever it goes and has a carefree personality that doesn't mind wherever it sets foot. It can dive and navigate underwater by spinning its tail.

species.name: Amphimon
species.flavor: A Cyborg Digimon that wanders about everywhere in the vast "Net Ocean", forging connections with various marine Digimon. It is capable of diving into ultra-high pressure zones thanks to the Bodysuit that covers its whole body, and has even intruded the "Abyss Sanctuary", which is constructed at the extreme depths of the sea. Like Angel Digimon and God Man Digimon, it is permitted to pass judgment upon those judged to be evil in the Net Ocean.

species.name: Arcturusmon
species.flavor: A mysterious Digimon that is said to have evolved by concentrating dark, evil energy to the extreme. In a study on certain Digimon that produce the secretion known as GRB Factor, it was found that they "theoretically" evolved when a simulation was conducted in which large amounts of GRB Factor were injected into the Digimon that produce it themselves to their limit. Although the simulation was repeated hundreds of times, all of the simulation results confirmed that they would evolve into this Digimon, so it is theorized to be a Digimon that can manifest even in the real Digital World as long as the conditions are met.

species.name: Baalmon (X-Antibody)
species.flavor: As an enlightened Digimon that excels in all knowledge, it is called the "Sublime Lord". According to one theory, it is surely another form of a certain Demon Lord Digimon. It is said that in exchange for the reader's soul, it will grant one page of information from the "Red Book of Appin", which records all of its knowledge.

species.name: Bombermon
species.flavor: The self-proclaimed "Explosive Artist" who loves explosions more than anything else. Its sole governing principle is about how beautifully the bombs it creates will detonate, and has no feelings regarding the damage caused by their explosions. It is capable of generating its standalone "BB" bombs by snapping the fingers on its left hand.

species.name: Chamblemon
species.flavor: A Plant Digimon in the shape of an extremely poisonous mushroom. It is a mystery whether it evolved from Mushmon, or if it is another variant. Although it is often seen as being weak, it is quite the ruffian.

species.name: Diarbbitmon
species.flavor: An astute Beast Knight Digimon that protects the nature-rich land inhabited by many Beast Digimon. It has a gentle personality and prefers spending its time quietly while interacting with the Digimon around it. If an enemy that threatens the land appears, it will draw its two cherished swords, "Móralltach" and "Beagalltach", and drive the enemy back with its nimble movements.

species.name: Espimon
species.flavor: A Cyborg Digimon that immediately flies in to investigate whenever it catches wind of gossip and suspicion flowing into the Digital World. It will bravely infiltrate places in order to find out the truth, even if they are inhabited by dangerous Digimon. When it switches its eyes to Search Mode, it is able to clearly see objects several kilometers away.

species.name: Fumamon
species.flavor: A ninja Digimon that has mastered the excellent assassination technique of Fuma-ryu Ninjutsu. It makes its living as an assassin, disposing of its targets upon receiving a request. It specializes in melee attacks that capitalize on its outstanding physical ability, but since it also utilizes projectile weapons such as shuriken, it has attack styles that leave few openings, even at mid and long-range.

species.name: Lianpumon
species.flavor: A Mutation Digimon that wears a distinctive mask. It has a cheerful personality that loves the festive atmosphere, and will switch between various masks to try to liven up the mood. If a mask is removed, another one will immediately emerge from beneath, so no one has seen its true face behind the mask.

species.name: Oboromon
species.flavor: An Undead Digimon that lives in graveyards like a ghost, it is a berserker who never backs down against superior opponents and fights by any means necessary. It is thought that the reason it has an unusually intense obsession with victory is because it has taken in a large amount of hatred data from the Digimon it has defeated. On the other hand, it has virtually no sense of self, and when it isn't fighting, it wanders around the graveyard foolishly, and has occasionally been witnessed conversing suspiciously with the beast skull fused to its left arm.

species.name: Oleamon
species.flavor: An Insectivorous Plant Digimon confirmed to inhabit the forest regions of the Digital World. The scent emitted from its flower lures Insect Digimon in particular. It wraps its tongue around prey entranced by its scent to taste them, and then preys on them with its "Jameal", in which it spreads its petals wide.

species.name: Xiangpengmon
species.flavor: A Holy Bird Digimon referred to as a phantom, it has a body large enough to cover a mountain. It usually sleeps peacefully at the depths of the Net Ocean. While sleeping, Xiangpengmon's data regulates the surrounding environment.

species.name: Xingtianmon
species.flavor: An Oni (Warrior) Digimon with a unique appearance resembling an enormous face with limbs growing from it. It may sound good to say that it has an indomitable fighting spirit, but it is actually a stubborn Digimon that never accepts defeat, no matter how disadvantageous the situation is.    If someone makes fun of its appearance or its battle situation becomes disadvantageous, it will express its anger by letting out a war cry while swinging the axe in its right hand.

species.name: Xiquemon
species.flavor: A different kind of Bird Digimon that travels freely in the air and water. It contains fish data within its Digicore, and dives directly into the water from a flying position, swimming and hunting as if it were flying. It is said that the reason why it wears goggles is to protect its vision while swimming.

species.name: Zanmetsumon
species.flavor: A swordmaster Digimon that freely wields five swords. It wanders the Digital World and devotes itself to battle, thinking only about honing its sword techniques. It is capable of unleashing slash attacks in all directions from the swords it holds in its four hands and the one equipped to its tail, so it is difficult even for those with considerable skill to avoid them completely.

species.name: Proximamon
species.flavor: A mysterious Digimon that is said to govern over destruction and creation, and possess immense power. Since it is a Digimon whose "theoretical" manifestation was predicted in a simulation on a high-speed computing device, it is unknown whether it exists in the real Digital World. It has the ability to generate the opposing forces of holy energy and evil energy, and is said to be capable of disassembling every constituent substance in the Digital World with evil energy, and reconstructing the disassembled substances with holy energy to create new ones.

species.name: Publimon
species.flavor: A Mutation Digimon wearing a shell hood that loves observing other Digimon, and transmits the data it has compiled on them throughout the Digital World. Since the content is very trivial, it will occasionally report things regardless of whether it puts its life at risk, for example, clashing with Angel Digimon for taking an interest in the Three Archangels. Although it is supported by a large number of readers due to the content that it publishes, there are many readers who detest it.

species.name: Regulusmon
species.flavor: An Evil Dragon Digimon that plots to rule through rage and fear. Despite being a Perfect, it boasts a power that is reminiscent of Megidramon, one of the Four Great Dragons Digimon who is renowned for being the most evil, and so Regulusmon's arrival is nothing short of a disaster. Its body is the source of an infection known as "GRB" (Gulus Realm Burst), and it is said that Digimon infected with "GRB Factor" have their personalities altered and become frenzied.

species.name: ShinMonzaemon
species.flavor: A Puppet Digimon that evolved as a result of Monzaemon taking in nightmare-related analysis data. At first glance, it is shaped like a teddy bear, but it is actually a fluffy, amorphous Digimon with a mysterious nature, like a cross between slime and clouds. It is a moody Digimon that has a childish personality and does not act intelligently.

species.name: Siriusmon
species.flavor: An Ultimate-level Light Dragon Digimon that is affiliated with the group of justice, the Virus Busters. Whenever it senses a voice crying for help or malice, even from far away, it will descend like a comet and bring down the enemy with the "Sylvia" composite cannon-blades equipped to both its arms. However, it is a kind-hearted being who brightens up everything around it such that if it senses a change of heart in its opponent during battle, it will lay down its arms and open up to them.

species.name: Ghilliedhumon
species.flavor: A Digimon that inhabits forested areas and specializes in sniping. Its skill as a hunter is very high, and it blends in with the forest using the camouflage suit that covers its whole body and snipes without its prey knowing its location. Although it is a Digimon with a calm disposition, it has a strong attachment to its territorial hunting grounds, so those who carelessly step into Ghilliedhumon's hunting grounds will be sniped without warning.

species.name: Greymon (Blue) (X-Antibody)
species.flavor: A Virus attribute Greymon with a bluish-black body. While it has been called a feral Greymon, befitting its more violent disposition, it is in no way a lone wolf and possesses enough intelligence to work together with its allies as a team. Its Special Move is a blast of high-temperature flames spewed from its mouth (Mega Flame).

species.name: Gyukimon
species.flavor: A Demon Beast Digimon with an ox-like upper body and a spider lower body. With a brutal and insidious personality, it is a monster that chases after those who see it for days, and launches surprise attacks from behind every night. Despite its large build, it skillfully uses its spider legs to move quietly without making a sound.

species.name: HoverEspimon
species.flavor: Having succeeded in multiple investigations, Espimon has become highly mobilized so that it can obtain more accurate information. It can now navigate over long distances, fly, and dive, and its field of activity extends to the depths of the "Net Ocean" and altitudes of up to 20,000m, making it possible for it to investigate hidden Digimon. Its "Divanish" optical camouflage has also been updated.

species.name: Huanglongmon (Ruin Mode)
species.flavor: A form of Huanglongmon that went berserk after being imbued with malice energy. Having lost its goodness and light, it became a being inclined towards evil and darkness alone, and rampages to bring the world to ruin. According to records, the Four Holy Beasts joined forces and succeeded in subduing the rampant Huanglongmon.

species.name: Huankunmon
species.flavor: A giant Aquatic Digimon whose whole body is covered in scales boasting a hardness rivaling that of Chrome Digizoid. It has a gentle personality, prefers clear water, and protects the areas around lakes from environmental pollution. When feeding, it will jump out of the lake, move as if it is swimming in the air, and swallow flying Digimon whole to satisfy its appetite.

species.name: ArkhaiAngemon
species.flavor: A Principality-type Perfect Digimon of equal rank to Holy Angemon and Angewomon. It has a strong sense of concern for others, and is frequently seen interacting with various Digimon. Perhaps it is because of this personality that its fighting style specializes in defense, and since it also excels in ingenuity, it acts as both an adviser and commander in its assigned unit.

species.name: BigUkkomon
species.flavor: A Digimon that is thought to have appeared the moment the ancient Digital World was destroyed. It is said that it sacrificed its own life to summon a Digitama from the sorrow of the Digimon that disappeared one after another as a result of the destruction. However, there are no records of whether this act had been accomplished or not.

species.name: Bowmon
species.flavor: A Lesser Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. It takes interest in everything it sees, and has a habit of sniffing them out. Although it is an active Digimon, it immediately tumbles over when running due to its short legs.

species.name: Brigadramon
species.flavor: D-Brigade had perfected an Ultimate Digimon as their weapon of last resort in the past, but this individual caused a fiasco when it broke out after running wild. After reflecting upon their failure to produce the strongest and most unique Digimon to represent their organization, they evolved and developed a Digimon as a command aircraft for managing troops efficiently—Brigadramon. It circles above the mission area, searching for and destroying threats on the ground or at low altitudes.

species.name: Cargodramon
species.flavor: A Digimon in charge of troop transport for the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said to have evolved by taking in tiltrotor aircraft design data from the Real World obtained via hacking. It has excellent maneuverability that allows it to hover and fly at high-speed by adjusting the angle of the propellers on both of its wings.

species.name: Cthyllamon
species.flavor: Cthyllamon inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean, and is known by the alias "Phantom of the Ocean" due to the fact that only the skull pattern on its chest can be seen floating eerily in the dark sea. Instead of actively fighting on its own, it employs aquatic Digimon that are a lower Level than itself by brainwashing them, and has a crafty and cunning disposition. Because of its appearance, and since it is rarely ever seen, it shares many similarities with Marin Angemon, but the relationship between them remains unknown.

species.name: Dijiangmon
species.flavor: A Mutation Digimon with a grotesque appearance whose whole body is covered in leather. Since it doesn't speak nor try to express anything with its body, it usually just stands on the spot in an eerie silence. Generally speaking, it has no interest in self-expression, and is an evil Digimon that specializes only in robbing others of life.

species.name: Fenriloogamon
species.flavor: Fenriloogamon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a Digicore". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the Interface on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the data of the warg from real-world mythology within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is an "Ultimate Demon Beast", clad in silver armor and wielding an inexhaustible supply of magical power.

species.name: Fenriloogamon (Takemikazuchi)
species.flavor: The ornament around Fenriloogamon's neck, known as "Gleipnir", is inscribed with ancient magic, and it is said that when Fenriloogamon's Digicore is filled with strong "emotions", that magic is invoked, and is capable of materializing those "emotions". Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi is a form achieved by causing Kazuchimon to undergo a miraculous evolution using the effects of this magic. Its Special Move is "Shūkyoku Senjin Takemikazuchi", a deadly slash attack that it unleashes, harboring the power of lightning and magical flames within the "Takemikazuchi" greatsword held in its mouth.

species.name: Fusamon
species.flavor: A Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. Although it is a Digimon brimming with curiosity that loves to move around, it spends most of its time sleeping due to it tiring easily. When danger draws near, it will emit a high-pitched, threatening cry called "Puppy Noise".

species.name: Loogamon
species.flavor: A Demon Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. It is said that the data of the warg from real-world mythology is embedded within the deepest parts of its Digicore, and it exhibits behavior so violent that you would not expect it from a Child. At first glance, it looks like a cute puppy, but if one approaches it carelessly, they will be on the receiving end of a fierce counterattack.

species.name: Loogarmon
species.flavor: A Demon Beast Digimon that generates an enormous amount of magical power within its body. The amount of magical power it generates is extraordinary, so it constantly releases it from its mouth in the form of flames. These flames have enough burning and spreading power to incinerate its surroundings just by roaring.

species.name: Luxmon
species.flavor: An Angel Digimon with a small, child-like body that belongs to the lowest rank among angels. It is often teased by Impmon and Pico Devimon, possibly because of its pure, innocent nature which makes it incapable of seeing through lies. It does not possess much power due to it being a Child, but once in battle, it is able to demonstrate its true strength in fighting against superior opponents by working together with other Luxmon.

species.name: Soloogarmon
species.flavor: A Digimon that succeeded in controlling the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. Program code written in a special language lines the inside of the armor that covers its whole body, suppressing its enormous amount of magical power, which is transformed into raging magical flames, as if it were sealed magic. Soloogarmon is able to freely manipulate the magical flames by modifying the program code, and these manipulated flames can be utilized for all kinds of actions, such as attacking, moving, and posture control.

species.name: Takutoumon
species.flavor: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone.

species.name: Tlalocmon
species.flavor: A Mineral Digimon that can be said to be the avatar of nature, ruling over rain and thunder. It has the ability to bless dry land with rain, and inflict divine punishment upon those who destroy nature with lightning to purify them. It is usually cheerful and calm, but occasionally displays ferocity to the point of being brutal.

species.name: Pteromon
species.flavor: A Bird Dragon Digimon that flies about freely through the skies over vast forests. The horns on its head are soft, and serve more as sensory organs than they do for offense. It can acutely perceive changes in climate by reading the wind striking against its horns.

species.name: Quantumon
species.flavor: An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which floats above the vast "Net Ocean", shrouded by enormous clouds. Quantumon extracts huge amounts of data from the Net Ocean using the expansion devices installed on Larc, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Together with its Digimon followers, Quantumon implements the best measures it has formulated against disasters that are predicted to occur in the Digital World.

species.name: Shoemon
species.flavor: A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If someone tries to touch it, it will jump quickly and immediately flee. Due to its timid nature, it can acutely sense vibrations in the floor or ground it is in contact with, and quickly detect the presence of invading enemies.

species.name: Helloogarmon
species.flavor: A Digimon in a chaotic state, overflowing with an enormous amount of magical power, whose form was released through the Interface on its brow by the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. That enormous amount of magical power is transformed into magical flames, which keep spewing forth endlessly. The ultra-high-temperature magical flames have consumed even Helloogarmon itself, so nearly its entire body has been replaced by those flames.

species.name: Hi-Commandramon
species.flavor: A heavy infantry Digimon from the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said that many of those that are not chosen in "Selection-D", a special selection test that screens through 100 Commandramon, evolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a "shield", and defend assault troops of Commandramon with its enormous build and protective shield.

species.name: Cendrillmon
species.flavor: An Ultimate Digimon born from the data of the fairy tale "Cinderella". Despite its appearance, it inhabits volcanic regions. It is based at "Cinderella Castle", which is made of volcanic ash, and lives quietly so as to not attract the attention of others.

species.name: Chaperomon
species.flavor: A Perfect Digimon whose body is composed of data from ornamental dolls and fairy tales. It has taken on a humanoid form, but since its body is similar to a doll, its joints bend in the wrong direction, so it surprises those who see it. It carries a large amount of "Mini Monzaemon Gummies" in its basket, and eats them whenever it has free time, even when it isn't hungry.

species.name: Erlangmon
species.flavor: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It acts in accordance with its conviction to rid all Digimon of their wicked hearts, and others refer to it as an upright Digimon due to the way it is honest.    A master that wields the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo as freely as its own limbs, it is also accompanied by its sentient treasure tool "Kōtenken", which resembles the head of a giant dog, and cherishes it as its companion, appearing anywhere in an instant regardless of the situation when summoned, and excelling in surprise attacks.

species.name: Fluffymon
species.flavor: A Small Bird Digimon that operates while hiding within the luscious leaves of the forest trees. Although it is still unable to fly due to its wings being undeveloped, it is agile enough to dash up vertical tree trunks in one go. Its Special Move is a headbutt that capitalizes on its speed (Birdy Head).

species.name: Galemon
species.flavor: A Bird Dragon Digimon characterized by its large wings and blade-like horns. Its hardened horns are even more developed than Pteromon's, allowing it to quickly perceive any abnormalities in its surroundings through the wind they detect, akin to a sixth sense. It is an intelligent species that strikes the first blow by predicting not only environmental changes, but also threats such as enemy invasions or attacks.

species.name: Takutoumon (Wrath Mode)
species.flavor: The form that Takutoumon boldly Mode Changes into when throwing itself into great battles. The Bǎo Tǎ has materialized into armor, its white mouse-shaped karakuri has transformed into a trident, and its appearance is a manifestation of the data of an "Eastern God" who is identified with a legendary warrior.    It amplifies its own power by releasing the vast amount of fighting spirit it had stolen and sealed within the Bǎo Tǎ all at once.

species.name: Yolkmon
species.flavor: A Slime Digimon that still wears the shell from its Digitama. It has a carefree personality and lives its life by slipping into the nests of other Digimon. Because its Digitama shell acts as camouflage, it evolves while hardly being spotted.

species.name: Zephagamon
species.flavor: An Ultimate Digimon known as the God of Wind, it is an embodiment of the wind data that flows in the Digital World. It primarily operates in forest regions, and uses the wind to carry warm air, ripening the fruits of the trees, and protects not only Digimon but also the environment itself.     Zephagamon's Digicore, the source of its power, is situated beneath the wings on its chest, and is constantly protected by whirling winds.

species.name: Shoeshoemon
species.flavor: An agile Puppet Digimon that travels as if it is gliding through treetops on roller skates. It moves around restlessly, and dislikes staying still.    Its cheek pouches, where it usually keeps its food in, have a larger capacity than they look, and it can also place important items besides food in them to carry around.

species.name: GrandGalemon
species.flavor: A large Perfect Digimon renowned as King of the Forest. The armor covering it up to its wings and beak is coated with magic. It skillfully blends into its surroundings by reflecting light in a special way, and despite having large wings, it is also able to muffle sounds by flapping them.

species.name: Ryugumon
species.flavor: A Digimon with a beautiful appearance that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World. It constantly emits a faint light from its translucent body, charming those who see it.    Not only does it have a beautiful appearance, but also extremely high combat ability.

species.name: Shagaramon
species.flavor: A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryūshōgu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.    Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryūshōgu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryūshōgu by Ryugumon.

species.name: Skadimon
species.flavor: An Ice-Snow Digimon that rules over "Thrymheimr", a small, snow country somewhere in the snowy mountains. It appears to be a Digimon in the form of a giant snowman, but most of it resembles a powered suit made of ice. Skadimon's true form is the adorable fairy-like Digimon sitting inside the snow globe on its head.

species.name: Vespamon
species.flavor: A Cyborg Digimon that is considered to be one of the elite within the aerial, covert honey base, "Royal Base". While Cannonbeemon protects the base over a vast range with its large body, Vespamon is in charge of defending key facilities, using its inexhaustible supply of stamina and speed as assets. Protecting the queen, Queenbeemon—the highest ranked at the base—above all else, Vespamon are known as the "Royal Guard" elite guards, and it is said that a handful of the strongest among them are awarded codenames and evolve into Tiger Vespamon.

species.name: Forgebeemon
species.flavor: A Cyborg Digimon that belongs to the mysterious aerial, covert honey base, "Royal Base". While Waspmon is in charge of security for the base, Forgebeemon is responsible for the construction of the Royal Base. Its arm is equipped with an adhesive glue gun, and it uses the "Honey Glue" produced in its abdomen to bond materials together.

species.name: HeavyMetaldramon
species.flavor: A Digimon that evolved into the form of an ominous dragon that overwhelms those who see it by taking in data from heavy metal culture. It thinks of its battles as a show, has a belligerent personality in which it wanders around seeking "strong opponents" that are crucial for exciting its audience further, and will sometimes venture into the Dark Area, where evil beings thrive, in search of more exhilarating battles.    Its Black Digizoid-clad body makes the sound of metal rubbing against metal whenever it rushes about, and constantly emits some kind of "noise", such as making a roaring sound, from its guitar-shaped wings.

species.name: Invisimon
species.flavor: Remodeled by the Crack Team to be pivotal in diversionary tactics, Invisimon is an Ultimate Digimon that is endowed with optical camouflage functions, and also possesses outstanding mobility due to its body being made of Blue Digizoid. Due to its excellent stealth abilities, even the cracker that it is under the employ of may lose track of its whereabouts, despite its large build. Unless one is extremely skilled, it will be difficult for them to handle Invisimon.

species.name: Jougamon
species.flavor: A God Man Digimon that contains the data of a Chinese moon goddess. It is a calm and beautiful Digimon that usually lives in solitude on its ship known as the Kōkankyū, which resembles the moon. Although it seldom has the chance to show it off, Jougamon is a master of Ch'uan Fa, and uses its specialty kicking techniques and high mobility to make sport of the opponent in battle.

species.name: Lamiamon
species.flavor: A Dragon Man Digimon with delicate scales and fins resembling a dress. It has the ability to synthesize various types of poison, such as those that paralyze the enemy, or those that melt substances. Making poisons that gradually shorten the opponent's life is Lamiamon's number one specialty, and it is said that this is because it takes pleasure in watching its opponents suffer.

species.name: Nezhamon
species.flavor: A Cyborg Digimon with control over flame, born from the data of a certain young god from Chinese legend. It possesses three treasure tools, and has the ability to wield them skillfully.    Despite its short appearance, it is an arrogant ruffian with a belligerent personality.

species.name: Oblivimon
species.flavor: Whenever a Digimon loses their memories or their behavior becomes erratic, those around it should beware of Oblivimon's presence. Covered in a flying saucer-like shell, this Cyborg Digimon vanishes as it silently draws near. After drawing nearer until it is directly above its target, it captures them by freely manipulating its tentacles, and takes them into its body.

species.name: PolarBearmon
species.flavor: An Ice-Snow Digimon that Digimon from snowy areas evolve into by taking in data related to winter sports. It has the ability to create tools made of ice, and typically makes skis and poles to freely slide around snow fields. It enters the dens of Mojyamon and Hyougamon as it skis about, and often causes trouble.

species.name: Cernumon
species.flavor: A Holy Beast Digimon that has been sighted in the various forest regions of the Digital World since ancient times. The huge horns on its head and the pipes growing from its abdomen have a structure similar to wind instruments, allowing it to play a variety of music.    It usually has a calm disposition, spending its time playing music along with the bird Digimon that perch on its huge horns, but on the other hand, Cernumon will severely punish invading enemies that try to enter and cause harm to the forest while letting out a loud warning sound in order to protect it.

species.name: Dimetromon
species.flavor: A Reptile Digimon characterized by its large, frill-shaped sail. Its sail has the special characteristic of instantly healing wounds, even when damaged in battle. Since its sail grows larger each time it regenerates, individuals that have survived competition tend to have larger sails.

species.name: Dinomon
species.flavor: Dinomon is a pinnacle that Dinosaur Digimon finally reach after long battles.    An Ultimate Digimon that has awakened an ancient power, its tremendous energy appears as a glow on the surface of its body. Boasting astounding stamina and power, it tramples down the enemy with overwhelming force.

species.name: Elizamon
species.flavor: A Reptile Digimon characterized by its frill, which is soft like fabric. Its ears, which look like ribbons, are so good at picking up noises that they can react to even the slightest of sounds in their surroundings. It usually prefers inhabiting quiet areas, and folds its ears to shut out noise when sleeping.

species.name: Erlangmon (Blast Mode)
species.flavor: The awakened form Erlangmon puts on display after unleashing its power to the utmost limit only when eliminating enemies that it is incapable of defeating, even if they are observed with its third eye. It wears a transformed Kōtenken as armor, and the third eye above its head has the power to see through everything.    It fights while "observing" all things, including the opponent's thoughts as well, with its awakened third eye, and tears the enemy to pieces with the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo, which has turned into a gigantic energy form.

species.name: Landramon
species.flavor: A Mineral Digimon whose configuration data is made up mostly of sand. It claims the desert as its territory, moving around by blending into the sand in search of food. It bands together with herds of Sunarizamon to brace itself against invading enemies.

species.name: Loudmon
species.flavor: A Digimon that evolved by taking in data from a variety of musical equipment and violent rock music, the armor covering its whole body is equipped with several features, such as speakers that amplify the sound taken in from the mic on its chest, and an effector that processes its voice. It deploys its main speakers during battle, and starts singing at a very loud volume.    Those who face it are unable to perform at their best due to being exposed to the roaring sound emitted from its entire body, while Loudmon itself becomes even more excited by the sound.

species.name: MarinBullmon
species.flavor: A Mollusk Digimon whose whole body is covered in a mucus-like veil, it is often seen coexisting with Digimon such as Shellmon and Sangomon, who are also classified as Mollusk-types. Although it has an extremely strong sense of territoriality, and is merciless towards invading enemies that enter its territory, it also has a side with a strong sense of kinship, in which it tries to protect the Digimon it is in a symbiotic relationship with.    The mucus that covers its entire body is slimy, and reduces friction to the utmost limits.

species.name: Medusamon
species.flavor: A Dragon Man Digimon that evolved via data from a mythological monster. During battle, the sentient serpent-dragons growing from its head drive the enemy away, so its true form rarely moves and often assumes an elegant stance. Even if someone is able to endure the serpent-dragons' attacks, it can deal with them easily in close combat with its fanged boots and the stinger on its tail.

species.name: Proganomon
species.flavor: A Mineral Digimon with a turtle-like appearance that primarily inhabits desert regions. It uses its drills and excavators to break through bedrock and move underground, but each time it does so, it triggers earthquakes, causing hollows in the ground and the ground to collapse. At night, it retracts its hind legs into its shell, and travels long distances by expelling the sand and gravel stored in its body in search of a safe place to sleep.

species.name: Punkmon
species.flavor: A Digimon that evolved by taking in data on music and fashion from punk rock culture. Its personality is aggressive and rebellious, as if embodying the anarchic spirituality of punk rock. It is an anarchist at heart who rarely listens to what others say, and hates being ordered around or being part of a group.

species.name: Pyramidimon
species.flavor: A Digimon with an enormous figure that some Digimon evolve into by taking in data from ancient ruins scattered throughout the Digital World. Its body is comprised of sand data, and because it is constantly surrounded by a sandstorm, it keeps ordinary Digimon at bay.    As a result of absorbing ruins and the ancient data stored within them, it possesses extremely high intelligence and the power to hold its own, even when facing large armies.

species.name: Queenbeemon
species.flavor: A Cyborg Digimon that is the ruler of the "Royal Base", serving as its "Queen", and also has an ambitious side that seeks the endless expansion of the base. Possessing high scientific and technological prowess, it designed and developed the Royal Base itself.    In addition, it boasts remarkable information processing abilities, such as handling defensive layouts and commanding formations during battle all by itself.

species.name: Necromon
species.flavor: A Ghost Digimon of the highest class that took in data from various ghosts and horrors on the Net. Its characteristic gravestone-like sword, the "Grave-Blade", is a brutal weapon that brings death to those who touch it, despite being blunt. If it encounters a superior Digimon as it wanders around, it will bring them down by stabbing them with the Grave-Blade without making a sound.

species.name: Nezhamon (Crimson Mode)
species.flavor: A form that the once-boisterous Nezhamon transformed into upon realizing that it should use its power properly. The "Fukanirin" have turned into a motorcycle with flaming tires, and the short body it used to have has grown larger as well. It has gained two pairs of adjustable Cyber Arms, becoming a Cyborg Digimon that uses six arms.
